system:wipe-all-data: Deletes all children of userData (RuleDesk-Data), then app.exit(0). Order: closeDatabase → stop video proxy → rm → exit. Does not touch media download folders or DB backups under RuleDesk-Backups (sibling of RuleDesk-Data).
maintenance:detect-orphans: Read-only orphan report (posts without artist, playlist entries without post, FTS rows without post, ghost artist ids). SELECT-only; not on maintenanceQueue; no automatic cleanup.
maintenance:should-show-backup-prompt: True when autoBackupInterval is never and hasSeenAutoBackupPrompt is false (existing installs that still inherit never). Read-only.
maintenance:mark-backup-prompt-seen: Sets hasSeenAutoBackupPrompt=true so the one-time auto-backup opt-in dialog is not shown again (Enable, Not now, or dismiss).
db:create-backup: Consistent SQLite snapshot via VACUUM INTO into RuleDesk-Backups/ (sibling of RuleDesk-Data). Opens the backup folder in the file explorer. Retention prune follows backupRetention.
app:get-settings-status: Returns IPC-safe settings (no API key plaintext), including minimizeToTray (default true). Idempotent; cached until save.
app:save-settings: Partial upsert. minimizeToTray: when true (default), win/linux close hides to tray; when false, close quits. Read at close time (no restart). macOS close never quits (Dock).
db:get-posts: Paginated posts with filters. Always limited — see MAX page size in PostsController.
db:delete-artist: Deletes artist + cascaded posts. If that artist is mid-sync, cancels only their sync and waits for FTS finally (timeout → { ok:false, reason:sync_busy_timeout }); does not globally cancel Sync All.
booru:search: Provider search; auth/rate_limit errors surface as typed IPC errors to Browse UI.
